mapper.select: SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "personId", d.MNG_NO AS "managementNo", d.DEV_NM AS "name", d.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeType", d.BLNG_CLNT_ID AS "companyId", c.CLNT_NM AS "companyName", d.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode", d.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", d.JBPS_CD AS "positionCode", j.CODE_NM AS "position", d.DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClass", d.PART_ID AS "personPartId", p.PART_NM AS "personPartName", d.JNCMP_DT AS "hireDate", d.RETIRE_DT AS "retireDate", d.WORK_STAT_CD AS "workStatus", d.USE_YN AS "useYn" FROM TB_HR_DEV d LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=d.BLNG_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.PART_ID=d.PART_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JBPS' AND j.CODE=d.JBPS_CD ORDER BY d.DEV_ID

SELECT DEV_ID AS "personId", APLY_BGN_YM AS "fromMonth", APLY_END_YM AS "toMonth", MON_PAY_AMT AS "monthlyPay", MON_UPRC AS "monthlyRate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC WHERE APLY_BGN_YM <= #{toMonth} AND (APLY_END_YM IS NULL OR APLY_END_YM >= #{fromMonth}) ORDER BY DEV_ID,APLY_BGN_YM

SELECT DEV_ID AS "personId", STAT_SN::text AS "sequence", WORK_STAT_CD AS "status", BGN_DT AS "fromDate", END_DT AS "toDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT WHERE BGN_DT <= #{toDate} AND (END_DT IS NULL OR END_DT >= #{fromDate}) ORDER BY DEV_ID,STAT_SN
mapper.sql: d.dev_id AS "id",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS "name",d.emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",d.blng_clnt_id AS "companyId",d.grade_cd AS "gradeCode",d.job_cd AS "jobCode",d.sub_job_cd AS "subJobCode",d.jbps_cd AS "positionCode",d.drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",d.part_id AS "partId",d.jncmp_dt AS "hireDate",d.retire_dt AS "retireDate",d.work_stat_cd AS "status",d.home_area_cd AS "homeAreaCode",d.home_addr AS "homeAddress",d.telno AS "phone",d.use_yn AS "useYn",d.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",d.reg_dttm AS "regDttm",d.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",d.mod_dttm AS "modDttm"
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tb_hr_dev d LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=d.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=d.grade_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=d.job_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code e ON e.code_grp_id='EMP_TYPE' AND e.code=d.emp_type_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code s ON s.code_grp_id='WORK_STAT' AND s.code=d.work_stat_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(a.input_end_dt) AS withdrawal FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today}) a ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT p.mon_uprc FROM tb_hr_dev_prc p WHERE p.dev_id=d.dev_id AND p.aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} AND (p.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR p.aply_end_ym>=#{month}) ORDER BY p.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true
ORDER BY c.clnt_nme.code_nm g.code_nmj.code_nm s.code_nma.withdrawal p.mon_uprcd.dev_nm DESC ASC NULLS LAST, d.mng_no ASC,d.dev_id ASC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM tb_hr_dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tb_hr_dev_prc WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tb_hr_dev_skill WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY skill_nm FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY stat_sn FOR UPDATE
SELECT dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT a.asgn_id AS "id",p.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate",coalesce(m.mon_mm,0) AS "mm" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id LEFT JOIN tb_pj_asgn_mon m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.input_ym=#{month} WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today} ORDER BY p.proj_nm,p.proj_id,a.asgn_id

SELECT d.dev_id AS "id",c.clnt_nm AS "companyName",g.code_nm AS "grade",j.code_nm AS "job" FROM tb_hr_dev d LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=d.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=d.grade_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=d.job_cd WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}
SELECT code,use_yn AS "useYn",del_yn AS "delYn" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND code=#{code} FOR SHARE
SELECT clnt_id AS "id",clnt_type_cd AS "type",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE clnt_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT part_id AS "id",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT std_val::text FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='MM_OVER' AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE mng_no=#{managementNo})
SELECT mng_no FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_nm=#{name} AND jncmp_dt=#{hireDate} ORDER BY mng_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_dev_prc SET mon_uprc=#{rate},mon_pay_amt=#{pay},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
UPDATE tb_hr_dev_prc SET aply_end_ym=#{end},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE')
